acceptanceCriteria: Count of ALL outcomes attributable to open setups on the frozen eval corpus is recorded
If above an agreed threshold, a narrowing ticket is filed
body: Residual from PR #1096 (V1-1698): any setup reading through an unresolved import is recorded as open and forces ALL for every change reaching a shared read. Safe but possibly noisy; frequency on real repositories is NOT_OBSERVED.
title: Measure how often unresolved-import open setups force ALL in tests setup-select
